1 .  By the present writ petition the petitioner who is claiming the land owner of the land bearing Khasra Nos. 235/1, 236/1, 236/2, 237/1 237/2 & 246/1 measuring 0.231, 0.234, 0.084, 0.085,
0.0150 hectare respectively, situated at village Dhabadhih, PH No. 13, R.I. Circle, Tahsil Baloda-Bazar, District- Baloda-Bazar- Bhatapara, (C.G.).
The said land was purchased by the petitioner in the year 2011 by registered sale-deed (Annexure-P/1) from the owner / Bhumiswami Bisahu, Punauram, Pururam, Rameshwar, Gopal and Omprakash.

The petitioner preferred this writ petition seeking a direction to the respondents to decide the representation (Annexure-P/2) dated 10/07/2013 and to hold that the petitioner is entitled for compensation strictly in accordance with the provisions of Section 24(1) (a) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. From the perusal of Annexure-P/2 it appears that the petitioner has submitted representation Ashok Kumar Jain vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 3 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19731528/
1 before the Collector, Balodabazar-Bhatapara that the land of the petitioner has been used for construction of road by the Public Works Department of the State and requested the Collector to enquire the said fact and to grant compensation in lieu of the land used by the Public Works Department for construction of road.

entities.text: Ashok Kumar Jain vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner further submits that the land of the petitioner has been used by the State Government for construction of road, but no compensation has been paid to him till date.
The representation is still pending before the Collector, Balodabazar-Bhatapara.

3. Learned counsel appearing for the State submits that the representation of the petitioner is still pending and it has not been decided till date and the same would be decided within stipulated period.
4. I have heard learned counsel for both the parties.

5. As the petitioner has submitted a representation to the Collector on 10/07/2013 by requesting the Collector to enquire about the fact that the land of the petitioner has been used for construction of road by the PWD and to make payment of compensation in lieu of said construction over the petitioner's land.

It is directed that the Collector shall decide the pending representation of the petitioner within a period of 3 months from today, by examining the fact whether the land of the petitioner has been used for construction of road or not and the Collector shall proceed in the matter in accordance with law, if the land of the petitioner has been used for construction of the road.
6.
With the above direction, this writ petition is disposed off.

Sd/-/-
